attributes.action: BAN FIREWORKS FOR THE SAFETY OF ANIMALS AND CHILDREN
attributes.background: Every year when there is fireworks, I get scared for my dogs safety as my dog constantly shakes when the loud bans happen and it doesn’t make it better when teenagers are outside my house setting fireworks off. Would you like your children to be scaring animals and maybe even have them passing?

rejection.details:
We have two petitions that have opened very recently which, between them, pretty much call for what your petition is seeking. You may wish to sign them.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
